verdict.rationale: Anytime Mailbox documents per-item disposal choices from the app or web: you can ask the operator to open and scan, forward, or shred a given item. That covers on-request shredding and per-item control. The evidence does not show physical-mail storage windows (the 'unlimited online storage' claim is about digital scans) or any confirmation after shredding. Missing for 10: documented physical-mail storage/retention windows, shred confirmation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
